verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a public OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support. It ships an official Docker image and a CLI command that start this server, and its chat completion API documents tool_choice options, structured outputs and reasoning fields. A community user independently confirms using the OpenAI-compatible API with existing ChatGPT applications. Missing for 10: an explicit endpoint/authentication reference in the evidence, and machine-readable docs for agents (llms.txt returns 404).
